success_condition: Each original gap needs actual source, implementation and required independent/economic evidence; quarantine is not closure.

gaps.implemented: Effective-dated rule validation; prospective numerical rules cannot claim historical authority.
gaps.remaining: Actual 2022-2023 exchange tick/lot/minimum snapshots with available_at and effective intervals. Current exchange metadata is not this evidence.

gaps.remaining: Complete frozen family/direction/ratio/PRZ/stop/Type-I/II doctrine matrix. A PartialPlan supplied to the bridge is not certification of a pattern detector.

gaps.remaining: Adjudicated parent-child count selection, ownership and invalidation grammar; latest/highest-degree mechanical selection remains diagnostic, not doctrine closure.

gaps.remaining: Source-bound new P&F count line/segment, cause reset, downward-stride and readiness grammar. Broad design labels do not specify these numeric/source choices.

gaps.remaining: Bind and certify actual six detector and three hybrid event streams to complete owner invalidation and management contracts. Old events without these fields deliberately fail instead of inheriting arbitrary stops. No market producer recertification was executed.

gaps.implemented: No new economic outcome manufactured; synthetic cash/fee/quantity parity tested.
gaps.remaining: Qualified frozen-version replay after authority/runtime/reserve gates; no gain, positive expectancy or meaningful per-trade return proven by this engineering work.

gaps.implemented: Existing deterministic feasibility/FIFO/capacity/digest ordering; ADD priority, same-asset owner conflict rejection, no winner replacement, no school-score comparability claim.
gaps.remaining: No validated common economic opportunity value. Capacity is execution feasibility, not evidence of higher future return.

gaps.remaining: No scientifically justified universal dollar/percent minimum or expected-profit estimate. A target's geometric reward is not its probability of realization. Do not invent a distant goal merely to make rewards look large.

gaps.remaining: Separate source-bound higher-timeframe trend-owner grammar, eligibility, invalidation and management. Disabling native session exit globally is not that implementation.

gaps.remaining: None for this execution-mechanics contract. Full family/cause fidelity and economic edge are separate gaps, not certified here.

gaps.implemented: Existing Dow FSM refreshed each completed 4H from PIT-known trend/broad-confirmation observations; detects reaction/reconfirmation/reversal without waiting for a weekly event. Context-only; no invented funded stop.
gaps.remaining: Bind and certify actual completed-market breadth/confirmation producer to the wrapper and router. Inputs are supplied observations, not newly certified historical broad-market series; inherited volume input is recorded but not an invented veto.
